question: Does fixed whole-form weighting retain a conditional pairing advantage after accounting for the frozen local transition law and the complete two-stream inventories?
mechanism_scope: One fitted position-aware first-order spelling law versus its already frozen whole-frequency mixture. Not every local mechanism versus a true lexicon.

null_law.weights: W_ij is the product of frozen local probabilities for ALL cross-class transitions in the reconstructed word, including first-to-second and penultimate-to-last edges. Pool mask, endpoints, page and Currier remain unchanged.
null_law.cancellation_proof: Each same-class adjacency belongs entirely to one complete stream and retains its fixed positions; its total log contribution over all carriers is unchanged under partner reassignment. The first-unit factor also cancels because endpoints are fixed. Thus the cross-class-only product induces the full local-word conditional assignment law.
null_law.model_binding: If using1279weights and1308MIX/M1score, explicitly verify agreement of their fixed local transition tables on the declared domain before selection. Simpler coherent alternative is to use the frozen1308M1 full-word probabilities for both weights and residual denominator; that is a named prospective choice, not a post-result repair.

score.recommended: Additive log(frozen1308MIX(w)/frozen1308M1(w)) over reconstructed paired words; both positive on all strings. Compare observed against exact weighted expectation.
score.alternative_not_second_primary: The conditional model log-likelihood ratio is sum(log MIX/M1) minus log(Z_MIX/Z_M1), with both permanent normalizers. This is a normalized probability comparison rather than an unnormalized whole-form bonus. Select one endpoint prospectively.
score.avoid: H alone can assign zero; do not add smoothing or weights after seeing scores. No novel-word-only outcome filter.

exact_computation.compressed_state: Collapse identical donor S1 strings into J types with remaining counts b_j; retain ordered carrier rows. Define Z(t,b)=sum_j b_j W_tj Z(t+1,b-e_j), Z(N,0)=1. The b_j factor preserves labelled occurrence multiplicities.
exact_computation.mean: Alongside Z, propagate M(t,b)=sum_j b_j W_tj [M(next)+r_tj Z(next)]. M/Z is the exact conditional expectation of the additive residual score. Variance can be propagated similarly.
exact_computation.sampling_if_needed: Draw donor type with probability b_j W_tj Z(next)/Z(t,b), decrement and recurse. This samples the complete weighted conditional law directly; no MCMC mixing assumption.
exact_computation.cost: Up to product_j(b_j+1) count states, with reachable-layer pruning; duplicate streams may make this small but native feasibility is UNCHECKED. Exact enumeration means complete finite summation; floating/log-domain arithmetic still needs numerical tolerance and independent higher-precision checks.
exact_computation.preflight: Before any native score inspect only a locked computational-capacity census of duplicate stream counts. Fix a total-state/time ceiling in advance. If exceeded, stop; do not silently discard inconvenient pools or replace the law with MCMC.

research_outcomes.positive: Fixed local transition compatibility does not account for the selected conditional whole-form preference. Retain a nonlocal or latent word-selection contribution; no causal lexicon, linguistic morphology or meanings inferred.
research_outcomes.nonconfirmation: No residual lead under this frozen component and exact conditional law. Does not prove local sufficiency, erase1308unconditionalgain or undo1374coupling.
research_outcomes.capacity_failure: This exact-law comparison is computationally unexecuted, not scientifically negative. No automatic approximate null.

predecessors.GDT1374: Uniform independence contrast is already positive; this is a prospective stronger local-law reference, not revised1374significance.
predecessors.GDT1308: Already demonstrates unconditional whole-frequency predictive gain against fixed M1 and fitted synthetic controls. New contribution must specifically be conditional on complete stream inventories and masks.
predecessors.GDT1280: Its per-word bigram-preserving order alternative lacked required capacity. This different sample space exchanges partners and weights local probabilities; it does not preserve per-word bigram counts or reopen1280.
predecessors.GDT1333: Different expanded-primitive fusion choice. No word/siteincrement there is not a general no-whole-information result.
predecessors.GDT1371: Category allocation can dominate gains; conditional pairing gain still need not identify literal memorization.

decision_budget: At most10minutes source-free definition/capacity decision; do not launch a large permanent solver until a locked state-count census establishes feasibility. A selected implementation needs its own inclusive validation/publication budget.
claim_limits: Plug-in frozen probabilities can be miscalibrated. Rejection concerns their specified conditional law, not all local writing.
Native target data already exposed; this is selected after1374positive, not independent confirmation.
No new meanings, class labels, corpus, images, reserve or source alphabet.

append_only_corrections.original_retained: The original wording recommending ALL cross-class edges remains above as historical proposal text. My accompanying message incorrectly called INNER insufficient.
append_only_corrections.correction: With the1374 exact first and last units fixed within each full-mask pool, each omitted edge factor depends on only one stream, giving a row-only or column-only matrix term. Every assignment uses every row and column once, so these factors cancel. The existing INNER-score weights and full local-word probabilities induce exactly the same conditional assignment distribution when their transition tables agree.
append_only_corrections.proof: For first-to-second transition, first is a pool constant and second belongs wholly to S0_i or S1_j. For penultimate-to-last, last is constant and penultimate belongs wholly to one stream. First-unit and same-class transitions also depend on a single stream. Thus logPij-Cinnerij=a_i+b_j+constant; all permutation totals differ only by a constant.
append_only_corrections.consequence: Full-word M1 remains a coherent implementation choice and provides a cancellation check; it does not fix an error in1374INNERscore.
